segments.text: When the LORD restored the captives of Zion, we were like dreamers.

footnotes.text: + Or brought back the captives to Zion; or restored the fortunes of Zion
+ Or like those restored to health

segments.text: Then our mouths were filled with laughter, our tongues with shouts of joy. Then it was said among the nations,
The LORD has done great things for them.
segments.speaker: Unknown

segments.text: The LORD has done great things for us; we are filled with joy.
Restore our captives, O LORD, like streams in the Negev.
Those who sow in tears will reap with shouts of joy.
He who goes out weeping, bearing a trail of seed, will surely return with shouts of joy, carrying sheaves of grain.
